generationInputs.prompt: A kawaii-style translucent plastic sphere-shaped capsule with a clear top and translucent pink bottom contains a small plastic figurine. The figurine is a stylized peach with a raised pink clenched fist emerging from its center. The peach is sculpted with gradients of orange and light orange and has two green leaves at the top and a short brown stem. The pink fist has visible knuckles and fingernails and points upwards. Below the fist, within the peach's cleft, are stylized yellow and orange flames or radiating lines. Pink blossoms with dark pink outlines and green leaves peek out from behind the peach. Four-pointed white stars are scattered around the top half of the peach figurine. Below the peach and blossoms, sculpted in a semi-circular arc, are the words "FISTING CONCEPCIÓN" in rounded black capital letters with a thick white outline. The capsule sits on a white surface with even and bright lighting, minimizing shadows. The plastic has a slightly glossy finish.
